title: Belize: English, Kriol, Spanish and Garifuna in a small country by the reef
goal: Talk about the languages and the Garifuna heritage of Belize with the passive with ser.
grammar: the passive with ser + past participle

sections.title: Belize: English, Kriol, Spanish and Garifuna in a small country by the reef
body: In this lesson you read about Belize, a small country on the Caribbean coast of Central America where English is the official language. You will also read about its barrier reef and about the Garifuna people.
The grammar is one you know: the passive with *ser* + past participle, for saying what was done and by whom. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can say what was done, and by whom, with *ser* + past participle and *por*.
I can say which languages are spoken in Belize and which is official.
I can use the new words for reefs, languages and deportation.
